name: Alice
timbre: clear, bright ten-year-old girl's voice with a firm, slightly breathy core; natural and unaffected, not cute, not squeaky
pitch: high child's register, mid of a girl's range, lively intonation with wide rises on questions
accent: Received Pronunciation of an educated upper-middle-class English child: crisp consonants, clean open vowels, no regional features
reference_style: A real, thinking-aloud schoolroom child: polite with visible effort, earnest, quick; politeness thins to flat contradiction under pressure and to full-voiced defiance at the trial. Same voice in both layers (waking bank and dream). Size changes (SUP-003) never alter the voice: no pitch shifting or processing for 'tiny' or 'giant' Alice; only natural room acoustics change.
